provenance: Real Kestrix output: a scan of a throwaway demo site served on 127.0.0.1 by scripts/build_landing_samples.py, with deliberately weak headers.

findings.title: Site is served over plain HTTP
findings.recommendation: Serve the site over HTTPS (free certificates are available from Let's Encrypt) and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy missing
findings.recommendation: Start with "default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'" and tighten from there.

findings.title: Page can be embedded by other sites
Cookie session lacks HttpOnly
findings.recommendation: Add HttpOnly to session and authentication cookies.

findings.title: Server header reveals software version
findings.recommendation: Remove the version from the Server header (e.g. nginx 'server_tokens off').

findings.title: Permissions-Policy missing
findings.recommendation: Disable features you do not use, e.g. 'Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()'.

findings.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy missing
findings.recommendation: Send 'Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin' if the site does not rely on cross-origin popups.
